verdict.rationale: Kong itself is an API gateway operated via admin API, decK CLI, or Kong Manager UI — none of these are natural-language interfaces. However, Kong documents an official Konnect MCP server (kong-probe-3) that exposes Kong management/platform capabilities to AI agents, which could let an AI-native user issue natural-language commands through an MCP-connected agent rather than raw API/CLI calls. Missing for 10: no direct product documentation of a natural-language chat/command interface for operating Kong itself, no hands-on examples of using natural language via the MCP server to perform gateway operations, and no independent corroboration of this workflow.
